basic_details.job_title: BRIC IBSD Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: BRIC Institute of Bioresources and Sustainable Development (BRIC IBSD) has notified 2 project-based vacancies for the Project Associate I post under advertisement number IBSD/ADV/62. The engagement is temporary and co-terminus with the project for a tenure of three years or till its completion, whichever is earlier. The pay is Rs. 31,000 + 8% HRA per month or Rs. 25,000 + 8% HRA per month. Applicants must hold a Master's Degree in Biotechnology/ Life Science/ Microbiology/ Biochemistry/ or equivalent from a recognized University. Candidates can apply offline by sending the hard copy to the Sen

how_to_apply: Download the application form from page 3 of the official notification PDF.
Fill up the application form completely and affix a passport size photograph.
Enclose self-attested copies of mark sheets and certificates for all academic qualifications from 10th to Master's Degree, age proof, and category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/PWD) if applicable.
Enclose experience certificates (if any), an in-depth biodata/Curriculum Vitae (CV), and a copy of the Aadhar card.
Write the Advertisement No., Post Applied for, and Title of the project properly on the envelope of the application.

Send the hard copy of the filled application along with documents to the Senior Administrative Officer, BRIC-Institute of Bioresources and Sustainable Development (BRICIBSD), Takyelpat, Imphal, OR send the soft copy to the email address [email protected] on or before 28 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Associate I position under the project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential Qualification: Master's Degree in Biotechnology/ Life Science/ Microbiology/ Biochemistry/ or equivalent from a recognized University. Desirable Qualification: Candidates with hands-on experience in microbial cultivation, fermentation techniques, microbial enzyme assays, purification, and characterization will be preferred. Fellowship Criteria (National Level Examination): Scholars selected through (a) National Eligibility Tests—CSIR-UGC NET, including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) or GATE, or (b) A selection process through National level examination conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions are eligible for higher consolidated pay. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated fellowship of ₹31,000/- + 8% HRA per month if selected through national-level examinations like CSIR-UGC NET or GATE. Other candidates who do not fall under this category will receive Rs. 25,000/- + 8% HRA per month. The position is purely temporary, co-terminus with the project, and lasts for three years or until the project's completion, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled-up application form Copies of mark sheets and certificates of all academic qualifications (10th to Master's Degree) Age proof certificate Category certificate (in case of SC/ST/OBC/PWD applicants, as per GoI norms) Experience certificates copy, if any In-depth biodata/Curriculum Vitae (CV) Copy of Aadhar card

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify detailed selection stages or interview dates, other than stating that no TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview and incomplete documents will be rejected at the time of shortlisting.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for the Project Associate-I post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BRIC IBSD Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of application forms (hard copy or soft copy) is 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential qualification required for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Master's Degree in Biotechnology, Life Science, Microbiology, Biochemistry, or equivalent from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, with relaxations for reserved categories as per GoI norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary or fellowship provided for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The fellowship is ₹31,000/- + 8% HRA per month for candidates selected through national level exams like NET/GATE, and Rs. 25,000/- + 8% HRA per month for others.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates can submit hard copies to the Senior Administrative Officer at BRIC-IBSD, Imphal, or send soft copies to the email address [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project for three years or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. What are the email ID and mailing address for sending applications?
faq.answer: Applications can be emailed to [email protected] or mailed to the Senior Administrative Officer, BRIC-Institute of Bioresources and Sustainable Development (BRICIBSD), Takyelpat, Imphal.
